title: Candidate profile
description: Facts from a screening call. Every value carries evidence: the transcript turn numbers where the candidate said it.

summary.title: Summary
summary.description: Two or three neutral sentences summarising what the candidate said. No opinions or judgements about the candidate.

current_role.title: Current role
current_role.description: Their current job, the kind of company, how long they have been there and what they do day to day.

skills.title: Skills
skills.description: Skills the candidate named, each with the concrete example they gave. Use the not-discussed marker as the example if they gave none. An empty list if they named no skills.

wants_next.title: Wants next
wants_next.description: The kind of work and direction they want in their next role.

work_arrangement.title: Work arrangement
work_arrangement.description: Remote, hybrid or office, as they stated it.

notice_period.title: Notice period
notice_period.description: Their notice period and earliest start. If they changed their answer, the final answer, citing both turns.

salary_expectation.title: Salary expectation
salary_expectation.description: The figure they gave, in their words. If they declined to share, say they declined (this is not the not-discussed marker). Never estimate a figure.

open_questions.title: Open questions
open_questions.description: Questions a recruiter should follow up because an answer was missing, vague or changed during the call. Each cites the turns that raise it. An empty list if there are none.
